features.title: Enhanced Cloud Agent User Interface

features.description: TheAgent Managementwindow now includes a dedicatedRequeststab to track agent report downloads, on-demand vulnerability scans, and vulnerability scan status. Previously, there was no option in Cloud Agent user interface to track these actions.
features.title: Track Scan and Report Download Status with the Requests Tab

features.description: We are introducing theTag-based User Accessfor Cloud Agent. Tag-based access provides precise, scalable permission control, ensuring that each user can view and edit only the assets assigned to them.
features.title: Control User Permissions with Tag-based Access

features.description: Cloud Agent now supports activating a new Qualys application, TruConfirm, from the Cloud Agent user interface.
features.title: New Application - Qualys TruConfirm

features.description: We introduced a new tab,Additional Settings,in Cloud Agent user interface. The Additional Settings tab provides you with the following options:
features.title: Configure Additional Cloud Agent Settings in New Tab

features.description: Cloud Agent now gives you control over secondary binary updates, such as SwCA, Cloud Agent Passive Sensor (CAPS), and Deep Scan. This prevents unplanned changes in sensitive environments and keeps binary updates aligned with your maintenance schedule. This enhancement also offers a test window for newly released binary versions before deploying them on critical assets.
features.title: Control Secondary Binary Updates

features.description: We have updated the ETM Identity activation workflow to support independent activation. You can now activate ETM Identity without activating the dependent Qualys applications, such as Vulnerability Management (VM) and Policy Audit (PA). This removes dependency on the other applications to use ETM Identity features.
features.title: Independent Activation for ETM Identity

features.description: We have updated the default transfer and admin ports for peer-to-peer distribution to 7400 and 7401, respectively. These new ports avoid security conflicts in user environments and provide a clean, risk-free gateway for peer-to-peer content distribution.
features.title: Updated Default Ports for Peer-to-Peer Distribution

features.description: You can now preview the custom logo before applying it to a Cloud Agent. This enhancement helps you test the custom logo during upload and ensures the correct logo is applied to the asset.
features.title: Preview Cloud Agent Custom Logo

features.description: We have optimized the CPU usage limits for SwCA scans on Linux assets. The new CPU limit range for Linux assets is 10-99%. The optimized CPU limit provides smoother scan performance and reduces scan failures by preventing users from setting CPU usage to very low or very high levels.
features.title: Optimized CPU Limits for SwCA Scans

features.description: To learn more about Cloud Agent API updates, refer toCloud Agent Application 2.8 Release API.
features.title: Cloud Agent API Release Notes

features.description: The newQuantum Readiness custom widgetis now available in the Certificate View dashboard to help assess asset readiness for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). It provides a color-coded view of internal and external assets, highlighting PQC-supported and unsupported assets, TLS 1.3-enabled assets with and without PQC support, and assets using the older TLS protocols.
features.title: Introducing the newPQC Asset Readiness Widget
